title: Accumulation points of packings of $\mathbb{Z}^3$
exact_target: Can a sphere packing realizing the three-dimensional lattice accumulate anywhere other than a single point, including infinity?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000064 (AMR-099-0064). CC BY 4.0.
